name: William
source:
William used to be a prince but then he had to come to Luche to be a Roachrist. Even though, he still acts very princely and cares a lot about other people. He enjoys drinking tea and eating cake, which his friend/servant called Alastair makes for him. He also has the tendency to sparkle when he talks.

(from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/07/10/kago-no-naka-no-alicis-review/]Liemyx's Eroge Blog[/url])
